desc: Derive the visibility criterion and reduce the problem to adjacent-pair rational thresholds.
Implement the O(N) adjacent-pair scan with exact integer comparisons for the maximum threshold.
Fix positive-answer output to print 18 decimal places from the float quotient while retaining exact -1/zero handling.
Verify all samples and edge cases (N=1, zero threshold, negative thresholds, large 1e9 values) after the output fix.
